```flowproof
# Four writers draft in parallel; a judge runs pairwise comparisons and picks the best (ties go to the first).
workflow pick_best_draft
  needs prompt: text
  role writer can answer
  role judge can answer
  budget at most 20 credits, 20 calls

  fork 4 into drafts
    let draft = ask writer: "{prompt}"
    keep draft
  end

  let best = choose drafts by pairwise judge else first
  give best
end
```
